# Launch Template

<!-- TEMPLATE_LLMS_TXT: Replace this Launch Template example with the client's reviewed content before launch. -->

> Launch Template is a production-minded Next.js foundation for developers and business owners launching, rebuilding, or migrating a website with an AI coding agent.
> It combines explicit App Router pages, technical SEO, migration safety, deletable content features, and automated launch checks without imposing a page-builder runtime or design system.
> Last reviewed: 2026-08-25.

## Explore Launch Template

- [Launch Template](https://agenticwebsite.io/): See how the template combines bespoke design freedom with practical routing, technical SEO, migration, analytics, and launch safeguards.
- [Website launch use cases](https://agenticwebsite.io/uses): Compare the template's approaches to migrations, SaaS rebuilds, startup launches, and search-focused landing pages.

## Choose a launch path

- [Website migrations](https://agenticwebsite.io/uses/website-migrations): Plan URL inventory, direct redirects, page-signal preservation, release gates, and post-launch monitoring.
- [SaaS website rebuilds](https://agenticwebsite.io/uses/saas-website-rebuilds): Rebuild a SaaS site around buyer journeys, clearer information architecture, reusable pages, and safer launches.
- [Startup website launches](https://agenticwebsite.io/uses/startup-launches): Launch with a clear offer, focused conversion path, approved proof, measurement, and production checks.
- [SEO landing pages](https://agenticwebsite.io/uses/seo-landing-pages): Build landing pages around real search intent, useful copy, internal links, technical defaults, and reviewable quality gates.
